install.snippet:
extensions:
  {name}:
    name: {name}
    type: streamable_http
    uri: {url}
    enabled: true
    timeout: 300
ui_steps: Desktop: sidebar > Extensions > Add custom extension (remote type option not shown on page)
CLI: goose configure > Add Extension > Remote Extension (Streamable HTTP)

verification.gaps: Page says OAuth client id comes via CIMD or Dynamic Client Registration automatically. Custom headers not documented on page (bearer_header null). Page shows macOS path only (Linux assumed same, not stated). Surface is both desktop and CLI. .goosehints and hooks not researched. Vendor attribution not verified from page.
